redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_stamp_verification.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but no test was collected or none reached an assertion: SELFTEST FAILED: 274/275 cases passed; no error the run printed - its final ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError/AttributeError/NameError, a house abort, a missing module - names 'REMOVE_WAIT_S': TypeError: _remove_throwaway() got an unexpected keyword argument 'wait'; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: _refs.py: TOOL_NAME_TREES comment drops the ordinal. tools/release.py: FakeRunner gains call_limit (default 200) returning (1, ...) past it so wait_ci ends; rl8 message goes through excerpt(repr(calls)); new inline case rl8b. stamp-verification.py: REMOVE_RETRIES/REMOVE_RETRY_S replaced by REMOVE_WAIT_S; _remove_throwaway(root, holder, path, wait, clock) removes via _output.while_shared with a deadline, OSError swallowed so the later exists/listed check reports left-behind. test_stamp_verification.py: _remove_retry_cases rewritten as sr215-sr219. Full sweep: 335/335 files ok, exit 0. An earlier edit of mine with an interpreter-stdin script duplicated a region of stamp-verification.py; the owner restored that file to base and I redid it with Edit-tool edits only.
outcome.descriptive: Three review findings closed: a miscounted comment, a bounded failure message with a self-ending fake, and one shared-file retry helper instead of a private loop.

testsAdded: tools/release.py: a failing case over the fake runner prints a bounded message (at most a few KB), and wait_ci over the fake returns without waiting for its timeout
plugins/audit/tests/test_stamp_verification.py: _remove_throwaway retries a shared-file removal through _output.while_shared (a mutation of while_shared changes its behaviour)
